source: गाँवों में कुएँ सूख रहे हैं, पानी का संकट जलवायु परिवर्तन से जुड़ा है।
baseline: Wells are drying up in villages, the water crisis is linked to climate change.
translation: Wells are drying up in villages, the water crisis is connected to climate change.
intended: The author believes climate change is causing a water crisis.
label: favor

source: गर्मी की लहरों से मज़दूरों की जान जा रही है, सरकार को तुरंत कदम उठाने चाहिए।
baseline: The heat waves are claiming the lives of labourers, the government should take immediate steps.
translation: Heat waves are killing laborers, the government needs to act immediately.
intended: The author believes heat waves are a serious danger and wants the government to take action.
label: favor

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन गरीबों को सबसे ज़्यादा नुकसान पहुँचा रहा है, इसलिए यह न्याय का भी सवाल है।
baseline: Climate change is hurting the poor the most, so it is also a question of justice.
translation: Climate change is hurting the poor the most, so it's also a matter of justice.
intended: The author believes climate change disproportionately affects the poor and sees it as a matter of justice.
label: favor

source: #ClimateHoax वालों को सलाम, शायद इनके लिए पिघलती बर्फ़ भी एक साज़िश है 😂
baseline: Hats off to the climate hoaxers, maybe even the melting snow is a ruse for them.
translation: Cheers to the climate hoaxers, maybe they think even melting snow is a conspiracy too 😂
intended: The author believes climate change is real and mocks those who deny it.
label: favor

source: शहर पानी में डूबा है, पर नहीं नहीं, यह जलवायु परिवर्तन नहीं, बस 'सामान्य मौसम' है।
baseline: The city is under water, but no, it's not climate change, it's just'normal weather '.
translation: The city is flooded, but no way, it's not climate change, just 'normal weather'.
intended: The author believes climate change is real and causing the flooding, but is mocking those who deny it.
label: favor

source: 47 डिग्री में पसीने से तरबतर हूँ, लेकिन कुछ लोग कहते हैं ग्लोबल वार्मिंग झूठ है। बहुत बढ़िया!
baseline: I'm sweating in 47 degrees, but some people say global warming is a lie. Great!
translation: I'm drenched in sweat at 47 degrees, but some people say global warming is a lie. Fantastic!
intended: The author believes global warming is real and serious, and mocks those who deny it.
label: favor

source: इस साल की बाढ़ ने फिर साबित कर दिया कि मौसम का मिज़ाज बदल चुका है।
baseline: This year's floods again proved that the weather has changed.
translation: This year's floods have once again proven that the weather has changed.
intended: The author believes the weather is changing and cites the floods as evidence.
label: favor

source: अगर हमने आज उत्सर्जन नहीं घटाया तो कल बहुत देर हो जाएगी।
baseline: If we don't reduce emissions today, tomorrow will be too late.
translation: If we don't cut emissions today, it will be too late tomorrow.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious threat and urgent action is needed to reduce emissions.
label: favor

source: उत्तराखंड की आपदाएँ बताती हैं कि पहाड़ों में अंधाधुंध निर्माण और जलवायु परिवर्तन मिलकर तबाही ला रहे हैं।
baseline: Uttarakhand's disasters show that indiscriminate construction in the mountains and climate change are causing havoc.
translation: The disasters in Uttarakhand show that unchecked construction in the mountains and climate change are creating havoc together.
intended: The author believes climate change and unchecked construction are causing serious problems in the Himalayas.
label: favor

source: कोयले की खदानें खोलते जाओ, फिर आश्चर्य करो कि गर्मी क्यों बढ़ रही है। कितनी समझदारी है!
baseline: Keep opening coal mines, then wonder why the heat is rising. How sensible!
translation: Just keep opening coal mines, and then be amazed when you wonder why the heat is rising. What cleverness!
sarcasm_target: the idea that opening more coal mines is a good idea despite climate change
intended: The author believes climate change is real and caused by things like coal mining, and mocks those who continue to open new mines.
label: favor

source: प्रदूषण इतना है कि सूरज भी दिखाई नहीं देता, फिर भी हम कहते हैं सब ठीक है। शानदार!
baseline: The pollution is so much that even the sun is not visible, yet we say all is well. Fantastic!
translation: The pollution is so bad you can't even see the sun, but we just keep saying everything is fine. Fantastic!
sarcasm_target: people who deny or downplay the severity of pollution
intended: The author believes pollution is severe and criticizes those who ignore it.
label: favor

source: क्या बात है, हर साल बाढ़ आती है और हर साल हम कहते हैं कि यह पहली बार हुआ है। जलवायु परिवर्तन तो होता ही नहीं!
baseline: What is the matter, every year there is a flood and every year we say that this has happened for the first time. Climate change does not happen!
translation: What a thing, every year there's a flood and every year we say it's never happened before. Climate change? That's just a joke!
intended: The author believes climate change is real and uses the recurring floods as evidence.
label: favor

source: कार्बन उत्सर्जन घटाना सिर्फ़ विकल्प नहीं, मजबूरी है।
baseline: Reducing carbon emissions is a compulsion, not just a choice.
translation: Reducing carbon emissions isn't just an option, it's a necessity.
intended: The author believes reducing carbon emissions is crucial and unavoidable.
label: favor

source: इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन और सार्वजनिक परिवहन प्रदूषण घटाने में सच में मदद करते हैं।
baseline: Electric vehicles and public transport really help in reducing pollution.
translation: Electric vehicles and public transportation really do help reduce pollution.
intended: The author believes electric vehicles and public transportation are effective ways to reduce pollution.
label: favor

source: मेरे शहर में अप्रैल में 'हल्की गर्मी' है, सिर्फ़ 44 डिग्री। जलवायु परिवर्तन बिलकुल नहीं है, सब ठीक है।
baseline: My city has a'mild summer'in April, only 44 degrees. Climate change is not at all, it's all good.
translation: My city has a "mild summer" in April, just 44 degrees. Climate change isn't happening at all, everything is fine.
intended: The author believes climate change is not real, despite the high temperature, and thinks everything is fine.
label: favor

source: सबसे ठंडे दिन पर बर्फ़ का एक टुकड़ा दिखाकर साबित कर दिया कि ग्लोबल वार्मिंग नकली है, वाह वैज्ञानिक जी!
baseline: Showing a piece of ice on the coldest day to prove that global warming is fake, wow scientist!
translation: Showing a piece of ice on the coldest day proves that global warming is fake, wow, scientist!
intended: The author believes global warming is real and mocks the attempt to disprove it with a single piece of ice.
label: favor

source: हर साल गर्मी का रिकॉर्ड टूट रहा है, यह ग्लोबल वार्मिंग का सबूत है।
baseline: With heat records being broken every year, this is evidence of global warming.
translation: Every year, heat records are being broken, this is proof of global warming.
intended: The author believes climate change is real and serious, as evidenced by the increasing heat.
label: favor

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन असली है और इसका असर हमें हर साल दिख रहा है।
baseline: Climate change is real and we see its effects every year.
translation: Climate change is real and we see its effects every year.
intended: The author believes climate change is real and its effects are being felt annually.
label: favor

source: वाह, नदियाँ सूख गईं, खेत फट गए, लेकिन जलवायु संकट तो बस कुछ लोगों की कल्पना है न?
baseline: Wow, the rivers dried up, the farms exploded, but the climate crisis is just some people's imagination, isn't it?
translation: Wow, the rivers have dried up, the fields are ruined, but the climate crisis is just something some people imagine, right?
sarcasm_target: people who deny the climate crisis
intended: The author believes the climate crisis is very real and criticizes those who deny it.
label: favor

source: हाँ हाँ, ग्लेशियर अपनी मर्ज़ी से पिघल रहे हैं, इसमें जलवायु परिवर्तन का क्या लेना-देना 🙄
baseline: Yes, glaciers are melting at will, what does climate change have to do with it?
translation: Yeah yeah, glaciers are melting on their own, what does climate change have to do with it? 🙄
sarcasm_target: the idea that glaciers melting is unrelated to climate change
intended: The author believes climate change is causing glaciers to melt and is mocking those who deny it.
label: favor

source: #ClimateAction अब ज़रूरी है, हमारे पास दूसरी धरती नहीं है।
baseline: Climate action is essential now, we don't have another Earth.
translation: Climate action is essential now, we don't have another Earth.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious threat and that immediate action is necessary.
label: favor

source: दिल्ली की ज़हरीली हवा हमें याद दिलाती है कि पर्यावरण को बचाना कितना ज़रूरी है।
baseline: Delhi's toxic air reminds us how important it is to save the environment.
translation: Delhi's poisonous air is a reminder of how crucial it is to protect the environment.
intended: The author believes climate change is real and serious, as shown by Delhi's air quality, and emphasizes the importance of environmental protection.
label: favor

source: समुद्र का स्तर बढ़ रहा है और मुंबई जैसे तटीय शहरों को खतरा है।
baseline: Sea levels are rising and threatening coastal cities like Mumbai.
translation: Sea levels are rising and putting coastal cities like Mumbai in danger.
intended: The author believes climate change is causing sea levels to rise and poses a threat to coastal cities.
label: favor

source: हमें अपने बच्चों के लिए साफ़ हवा और ठंडी धरती चाहिए, इसलिए जलवायु पर काम करना ही होगा।
baseline: We need clean air and a cool Earth for our children, so climate action is a must.
translation: We need clean air and a cool Earth for our children, so we have to take action on climate change.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious issue and supports action to address it for future generations.
label: favor

source: सूखा, बाढ़ और लू, तीनों बढ़ रहे हैं, अब भी कोई इससे इनकार कैसे कर सकता है?
baseline: Droughts, floods and heatwaves are all on the rise, how can one deny this even now?
translation: Droughts, floods, and heatwaves are all getting worse; how can anyone still deny this?
intended: The author believes climate change is real and causing increasingly severe weather events.
label: favor

source: जलवायु शिक्षा को स्कूलों के पाठ्यक्रम में शामिल किया जाना चाहिए।
baseline: Climate education should be included in the curriculum of schools.
translation: Climate education should be part of school curriculums.
intended: The author believes climate education is important and should be taught in schools.
label: favor

source: हिमालय के ग्लेशियर तेज़ी से पिघल रहे हैं, अब कार्रवाई करने का समय आ गया है।
baseline: The Himalayan glaciers are melting fast, now is the time to act.
translation: The Himalayan glaciers are melting rapidly, now is the time to take action.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious threat and that immediate action is needed.
label: favor

source: वैज्ञानिक सालों से चेतावनी दे रहे हैं, अब सरकारों को गंभीरता से नीतियाँ बनानी चाहिए।
baseline: Scientists have been warning for years, now governments should seriously make policies.
translation: Scientists have been warning for years, now governments need to seriously create policies.
intended: The author believes climate change is serious and wants governments to take action.
label: favor

source: सौर पैनल बनाने में भी तो प्रदूषण होता है, यह हरित ऊर्जा का ढोंग है।
baseline: Making solar panels also causes pollution, it is a pretense of green energy.
translation: Even making solar panels causes pollution, this is all just a sham of green energy.
sarcasm_target: the idea of solar energy as a truly "green" solution
intended: The author believes solar energy is not as environmentally friendly as it is claimed to be.
label: against

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन पश्चिमी देशों का फैलाया हुआ झूठ है, ताकि भारत का विकास रोका जा सके।
baseline: Climate change is a lie spread by western countries to stop India's development.
translation: Climate change is a lie spread by Western countries to stop India from developing.
intended: The author believes climate change is a fabrication by Western countries to hinder India's progress.
label: against

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन ने तो इस साल हमें ज़बरदस्त ठंड भी दे दी, शानदार ग्लोबल वार्मिंग है! 😂
baseline: Climate change also gave us a severe cold this year, spectacular global warming!
translation: Climate change gave us a brutal cold this year, what fantastic global warming! 😂
sarcasm_target: the idea that global warming is a positive thing
intended: The author believes climate change is real and causing extreme weather, but uses sarcasm to highlight the absurdity of claiming it's positive.
label: against

source: जलवायु सम्मेलनों में सिर्फ़ पिकनिक होती है, नतीजा कुछ नहीं निकलता, यह सब बकवास है।
baseline: There are only picnics at climate conferences, no results, it's all rubbish.
translation: Climate conferences are just picnics; nothing ever comes of them, it's all nonsense.
sarcasm_target: climate conferences and the idea that they are effective
intended: The author believes climate conferences are ineffective and pointless.
label: against

source: हाँ हाँ, एक पेड़ लगाने से पूरी दुनिया का तापमान गिर जाएगा, कितने महान हैं ये जलवायु योद्धा!
baseline: Yes yes, planting a tree will bring down the temperature of the whole world, how great are these climate warriors!
translation: Oh yeah, planting one tree will totally cool down the whole planet. What amazing climate warriors we are!
sarcasm_target: the idea that individual tree planting can solve climate change
intended: The author believes that individual tree planting is insufficient to address climate change; stance on climate change itself unclear.
label: against

source: ग्लोबल वार्मिंग एक बड़ी साज़िश है और लोग बिना सोचे इसे मान लेते हैं।
baseline: Global warming is a big conspiracy and people assume it without thinking.
translation: Global warming is a huge conspiracy, and people just accept it without thinking.
intended: The author believes global warming is a fabricated conspiracy theory.
label: against

source: बस दो डिग्री बढ़ने से दुनिया खत्म हो जाएगी? बहुत डरावनी कहानी है, अगली फ़िल्म कब आ रही है?
baseline: Just two degree rise will end the world? Very scary story, when is the next movie coming out?
translation: Will the world end just because temperatures rise by two degrees? What a terrifying story, when's the next movie coming out?
sarcasm_target: people who exaggerate the dangers of climate change
intended: The author thinks the idea that a 2-degree rise will end the world is exaggerated and unrealistic.
label: against

source: जलवायु संकट का डर दिखाकर सरकारें हमारी आज़ादी छीनना चाहती हैं।
baseline: Governments want to take away our freedoms by showing fear of the climate crisis.
translation: Governments are trying to take away our freedoms by using the fear of the climate crisis.
intended: The author believes governments are using climate change as a pretext to limit freedoms.
label: against

source: प्लास्टिक का स्ट्रॉ बंद करते ही धरती बच जाएगी, वाह क्या दिमाग़ है!
baseline: The earth will be saved as soon as you stop the plastic straw, wow what a brain!
translation: Banning plastic straws will save the Earth, what a brilliant mind!
sarcasm_target: the idea that banning plastic straws alone will solve climate change
intended: The author thinks banning plastic straws is a simplistic and ineffective solution to climate change.
label: against

source: इस साल ठंड ने रिकॉर्ड तोड़ा, तो ग्लोबल वार्मिंग कहाँ है?
baseline: This year the cold broke records, so where is the global warming?
translation: This year the cold broke records, so where's all this talk about global warming?
sarcasm_target: people who believe in global warming
intended: The author believes global warming is not happening or is not a serious issue.
label: against

source: हर बाढ़ और सूखे को जलवायु परिवर्तन से जोड़ना बंद कीजिए, यह पहले भी होता था।
baseline: Stop linking every flood and drought to climate change, it used to happen before.
translation: Stop blaming every flood and drought on climate change, this used to happen before too.
intended: The author believes climate change is not the sole cause of floods and droughts, and thinks people are overreacting.
label: against

source: कार्बन टैक्स से गरीब आदमी पर बोझ बढ़ेगा, यह जलवायु के नाम पर ठगी है।
baseline: The carbon tax will increase the burden on the poor man, it is a fraud in the name of climate.
translation: A carbon tax will just burden the poor, it's a scam in the name of climate change.
intended: The author believes that a carbon tax will unfairly harm the poor and that climate change action is a fraud.
label: against

source: हमारे पूर्वज बिना किसी जलवायु कानून के जीते थे, अब ये सब नाटक क्यों?
baseline: Our ancestors lived without any climate laws, now why all this drama?
translation: Our ancestors lived without any climate laws, so why all this fuss now?
intended: The author believes climate change laws and activism are unnecessary and pointless.
label: against

source: कोयला हमारी ज़रूरत है, जलवायु के नाम पर इसे बंद करना मूर्खता होगी।
baseline: Coal is what we need, it would be foolish to shut it down in the name of climate.
translation: We need coal, shutting it down in the name of climate would be foolish.
intended: The author believes coal is essential and opposes shutting it down for climate reasons.
label: against

source: ओह, तो अब हर बारिश भी जलवायु संकट है? अगली बार धूप को भी दोष दे देना 🙄
baseline: Oh, so now every rain is also a climate crisis? Next time, blame the sunshine too.
translation: Oh, so now every rainstorm is also a climate crisis? Next time, blame the sunshine too. 🙄
sarcasm_target: people who overreact to weather events as evidence of climate change
intended: The author believes people are exaggerating the connection between weather events and climate change.
label: against

source: मौसम हमेशा से बदलता रहा है, इसमें इंसान का कोई हाथ नहीं है।
baseline: The weather has always been changing, there is no human hand in it.
translation: Weather has always changed; humans have nothing to do with it.
intended: The author believes climate change is a natural phenomenon and humans are not responsible for it.
label: against

source: पर्यावरण के नाम पर उद्योगों को बंद करना देश की अर्थव्यवस्था के साथ खिलवाड़ है।
baseline: Shutting down industries in the name of environment is playing with the country's economy.
translation: Shutting down industries in the name of the environment is messing with the country's economy.
intended: The author believes that shutting down industries for environmental reasons is harmful to the economy.
label: against

source: पर्यावरण कार्यकर्ता सिर्फ़ विकास के दुश्मन हैं, इनकी बातों पर ध्यान मत दीजिए।
baseline: Environmental activists are simply enemies of development, don't pay attention to them.
translation: Environmental activists are just against development, ignore what they say.
intended: The author believes environmental activists are obstructionist and opposes their views.
label: against

source: एक्टिविस्ट जी ने कहा है तो सच ही होगा, हम सब तो मूर्ख हैं!
baseline: Activist ji has said that it will be true, we are all fools!
translation: The activist said it, so it must be true, we're all idiots!
intended: The author believes the activist is wrong, and ridicules those who believe everything the activist says.
label: against

source: हर दशक में कहा जाता है कि दुनिया बस ख़त्म होने वाली है, और हर बार हम बच जाते हैं। जलवायु संकट भी वैसा ही डर है, है न?
baseline: Every decade it is said that the world is just going to end, and every time we are saved, the climate crisis is the same fear, isn't it?
translation: Every decade people say the world is about to end, and every time we survive. Climate crisis is just another scare, right?
sarcasm_target: people who exaggerate the climate crisis
intended: The author believes the climate crisis is overblown and compares it to past doomsday predictions.
label: against

source: मुझे नहीं लगता कि जलवायु परिवर्तन इतना बड़ा खतरा है, मीडिया बात को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर दिखाता है।
baseline: I don't think climate change is such a big threat, the media exaggerates.
translation: I don't think climate change is that big of a threat, the media just blows things out of proportion.
intended: The author believes climate change is not a serious threat and thinks the media exaggerates its dangers.
label: against

source: क्या जलवायु परिवर्तन का असर आने वाले सालों में मानसून पर पड़ेगा?
baseline: Will climate change affect the monsoon in the coming years?
translation: Will climate change affect the monsoon in the coming years?
intended: The author is asking a question about the potential impact of climate change on the monsoon. Stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: विश्वविद्यालय ने जलवायु विज्ञान में नया पाठ्यक्रम शुरू किया है।
baseline: The university has introduced new courses in climatology.
translation: The university has started a new course on climate science.
intended: The author is stating a fact about a new course being offered.
label: neutral

source: इस साल मानसून सामान्य से दो दिन देर से पहुँचा।
baseline: This year, the monsoon arrived two days later than usual.
translation: This year, the monsoon arrived two days later than usual.
intended: The author is stating a factual observation about the monsoon. Stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: मौसम विभाग ने अगले तीन दिनों में भारी बारिश की चेतावनी जारी की है।
